title: Running Commentary on Torah 28 — B'nei Lan Beisa b'Avira d'Alma
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 28 — בני לן ביתא באוירא דעלמא
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **The ma'amar**: Athenians: **'b'nei lan beisa b'avira d'alma'** ('Build us a house in the air of the world'). He said a name, stood, and suspended himself **between heavens and earth**. Said: **'bring up to me bricks and mortar from there!'** They said: 'who can bring them up there?' He said: **'and who can build a house between heavens and earth?'**

intermediate.en: **Bechoros 8b**: "build a house in the air" → R"Y suspends himself bein shamayim v'aretz → "bring bricks up here" → they can't → "so who can build there?"
intermediate.he: **בכורות ח:**: "בני ביתא באוירא" → ר"י תולה עצמו בין שמים וארץ → "הביאו לי לבנים" → אינם יכולים → "אז מי יכול לבנות שם?"

beginner.en: **"א. **Misnagdim mevazim u'mecharfin yirei Hashem** — this is because they **receive Torah from talmidei chachamim shedin Yehudaim** (Zohar Pinchas 253b). Shedin Yehudaim receive their Torah from the **shedin**, who possess **Torah nefulah mi'alafin nefulim** (fallen alefs). Of these alafs: **Shlomo** (Melachim I 5:12): **'va'y'daber sheloshes alafim mashal, va'yhi shiro chamishah va'alef'** — Shlomo merited them **b'kedushah**, but when they fell, they fell into shedin."**

intermediate.en: **α. Misnagdim**=receive Torah from **shedin Yehudaim** (Zohar Pin 253b)→shedin→**Torah nefulah mi'alafin nefulim** (fallen alefs). Shlomo's 3000 meshalim/1005 shirim (Mel I 5:12) — fell via pgam.
intermediate.he: **α. מתנגדים**=מקבלי תורה מ**שדין יהודאין** (זוה"ק פינ' רנג:)→שדים→**תורה נפולה מאלפין נפולין**. ג' אלפים משלי שלמה + א"א שיריו (מל"א ה, יב) — נפלו בפגם.

scholarly.he: סעיף א. זוה"ק פינ' רנג:; מל"א ה, יב.

beginner.en: **"ב. When yirei Hashem suffer **charafos u'bizyonos** from these kofrim — the eitzah: **'anochi sola'as v'lo ish, cherpas adam'** (Tehillim 22:7) — for **charafos u'bizyonos**, the **segulah** is **bechina of tola** (worm) — through this bechina he defeats his enemies. **Tola = emunah** — **'ha'emunim alei sola'** (Eichah 4:5). Bechina of **Avraham** = **rosh la'ma'aminim** — **'v'he'emin ba'Hashem'** (Bereshis 15:6)."**

intermediate.en: **β. Yirei Hashem + charafos — eitzah: "anochi sola'as, cherpas adam"** (Teh 22:7). **Tola=emunah** ("ha'emunim alei sola," Eichah 4:5); bechina of Avraham=rosh ma'aminim (Ber 15:6 "v'he'emin").
intermediate.he: **ב. יראי ה' + חירופים — עצה: "אנוכי תולעת, חרפת אדם"** (תה' כב, ז). **תולע=אמונה** ("האמונים עלי תולע", איכה ד, ה); בחינת אברהם=ראש מאמינים (בר' טו, ו "והאמין").

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. תה' כב, ז; איכה ד, ה; בר' טו, ו.

beginner.en: **"ג. To come to **chesed** (Avraham's middah), the means: **hachnosas talmidei chachamim tzaddikim into his house**. **'Ha'machnis orchim talmidei chachamim amitiyim l'soch beiso, k'ilu hikriv t'midin'** — Chazal (Berachos 10b) on **'ish kadosh oveir aleinu tamid'**. By **shimmush** (serving them, standing before them), he merits chesed. **Kesubos 96a**: **'kol ha'monei'a talmido mi'l'shamsho — k'ilu...'** (one who prevents his student from serving him is as if...)."**

intermediate.en: **γ. Chesed via hachnosas T"Ch → shimmush** (Ber 10b "ish kadosh oveir aleinu tamid"; Kes 96a "ha'monei'a talmido mi'l'shamsho").
intermediate.he: **ג. חסד ע"י הכנסת ת"ח → שימוש** (בר' י: "איש קדוש"; כת' צו. "המונע תלמידו").

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. בר' י:; כת' צו.

beginner.en: **"**Peirush Savei d'Bei Asuna**: **'b'nei lan beisa b'avira d'alma'**. Those who try to structure their avodah on Torah heard from **shedin Yehudaim** — in truth have **nothing to rest upon** — as if trying to **build a house in the air**. Shedin Yehudaim **fly in the air, rest on nothing** — like shedin. R' Yehoshua's response demonstrates the impossibility, showing these builders that there is no foundation there."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: "b'nei lan beisa b'avira"=building on shedin-Yehudaim Torah (fly in air, no support). R"Y shows impossibility.
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: "בני לן ביתא באוירא"=בונים על תורת שדין יהודאין (פורחים באוויר, ללא משען). ר"י מראה אי־אפשרות.

beginner.en: **R"N editorial**: **"I heard from his holy mouth that this Torah hints at all the **kavanos of parshas ha'Tamid** we say in the morning. He explained to us a little — see in Kavanos and you'll see that all kavanos of parshas ha'Tamid are explained in this Torah. For it's explained in Kavanos that **Tamid subdues klipos of Asiyah** = AZ; **'olah'** = gematria **shem אב"ג ית"ץ** = chesed; **'va'yashkeim Avraham ba'boker'** (Bereshis 22:3) = Avraham = chesed = olah..."**

intermediate.en: R"N: Rabbeinu said this Torah hints at **all kavanos of parshas ha'Tamid** (morning). Tamid subdues klipos d'Asiyah=AZ; **"olah"=gematria אב"ג ית"ץ=chesed**; "va'yashkeim Avraham ba'boker" (Ber 22:3)=Avraham=chesed=olah.
intermediate.he: ר"נ: הרבי אמר שתורה זו מרמזת **כל כוונות פרשת התמיד** (בוקר). תמיד מכניע קליפות דעשייה=ע"ז; **"עולה"=גימ' אב"ג ית"ץ=חסד**; "וישכם אברהם בבוקר" (בר' כב, ג)=אברהם=חסד=עולה.

scholarly.he: תמיד/כוונות; עולה=אב"ג ית"ץ; בר' כב, ג.
